agent_executive_summary: 2BR investment batch, 5-7yr hold. Two clear Buys: D'Nest (D18, $1.39M/$1,382psf) — 912 units, honest 5.95% URA over 260 txns, below-median PSF, CRL catalyst — and Flamingo Valley (D15, $2.00M/$1,674psf) — freehold Siglap, 4.62% URA, ~12% under median, active en-bloc optionality and deep East Coast liquidity. The Trumps (D14, 190m to Kembangan MRT, asking at median, 7.14% URA) is a third Buy with a small-dev caveat. One Avoid: Astoria Park (D14) — documented failing roof waterproofing, water ingress, derelict common areas and special-levy risk on a 1995 lease outweigh its MRT-doorstep location. The rest are Neutral: Bartley Vue (small 115-unit, new-launch-inflated rate), The Antares (flat 1.73% resale URA, priced above median), Kovan Residences (good URA but ~7% over median plus build-quality complaints), Rivervale Crest (great MRT but ~13% over median on an ageing lease, batch-low score 303), Astoria Park's neighbour set, and Straits Residences (freehold value but 30-unit illiquidity and a 7-transaction 'appreciation' figure that can't be trusted).
agent_market_commentary: Jun 2026: leasehold-vs-freehold and data-reliability are the deciding axes this batch. Several headline URA CAGRs are distorted — new-launch base effect (Bartley Vue, The Antares) or tiny samples (Straits Residences 7 txns, Straits/Chiltern/Trumps thin) — so I leaned on resale-only rates with adequate transaction counts and on PSF-vs-median for value. Sub-$1.5M OCR/fringe entries (D'Nest, Astoria Park, Rivervale Crest) keep the widest upgrader pool; $2M+ (Flamingo Valley) needs freehold or a catalyst to justify the thinner pool. East-West / Circle Line MRT-doorstep stock (Trumps, Chiltern, Astoria, Rivervale Crest) commands transit premiums but several are ageing leaseholds where lease decay and deferred maintenance erode the discount.
agent_methodology_notes: Rated each 2BR unit type at the listed price/PSF for INVESTMENT (5-7yr hold). Quantitative case taken from the dossier; 1-2 web searches per condo for qualitative factors only. Could not independently verify current asking prices, individual unit facing/stack, or live en-bloc committee status (Flamingo Valley en-bloc interest is reported, not confirmed). Note: dossier labels Bartley Vue as D19, but it sits at Jalan Bunga Rampai (D13 fringe) — rated per dossier framing. Build-quality findings (Astoria Park leaks, Kovan defects) are from resident/portal reviews, not inspection reports. Thin-sample URA rates (Straits Residences 7 txns; Trumps 45; Astoria 58) were down-weighted rather than taken at face value.
